blocks.text: Translators woh tools hain jo ek programming language mein likha code aisi language mein badalte hain jo computer samajh sake. Translators high-level programming languages (jaise Python) ko machine language (binary code, yani 0 aur 1) mein badalte hain jise computer chala (execute kar) sakta hai.

items: Interpreters: code ko line by line translate karte hain (misal: Python interpreter).
Compilers: poore code ko ek hi dafa translate karte hain (misal: C/C++ ke liye GCC).

blocks.prompt: Interpreter aur compiler mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Interpreter code ko ek waqt mein ek line translate kar ke chalata hai; compiler poore program ko ek hi dafa machine code mein badalta hai.

items: Translators: high-level code ko machine language mein badalte hain; interpreter line by line (Python), compiler ek saath (GCC).
